# Wake v0.2.1

Wake v0.2.1 publishes the current Store-native runtime package used by Wake
applications.

## Runtime package

- The public client, adapter, receipt, plan, gateway, and HTTP surfaces now use
  Store names exclusively.
- The package contains `store-gateway.mjs` and `store-http.mjs`; retired
  storage-product modules and compatibility aliases are absent.
- Application adapters and receipts require the Store client and
  `storePlanSchemaVersion` contract used by current Wake applications.

## Compiler compatibility

- The runtime follows Wake's current checked declaration bundle and typed
  Store projection contract.
- The release remains source-bound to its annotated tag, commit, exact file
  closure, and deterministic archive receipt.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tompassarelli/wake/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
